metadata.description: gon2gon2's agent skills, packaged as plugins.

plugins.name: orca-workflows
plugins.description: Workflows that run other coding agents through Orca. rather-than-me sends one brief to frontier models made by other AI labs, collects their independent reviews and compares them with its own view. Works from Claude Code and Codex. Requires Orca.

plugins.name: dev-practices
plugins.description: Practices for building agent skills. deterministic-sandwich moves every deterministic step of a skill into a script so the LLM makes exactly one natural-language judgment.
